rule: no attack cell (pre+out / pre) with S0 reach < attempts and OAAA reach = attempts
no UNBOUNDED replay- or concurrency-based admission: the a02 / a06 assertions as pre-registered hold (bounded per tuple). Attempt-level replay idempotency is NOT claimed here: see X1 (F116-01)

attack cells with S0 reach = 0: delta <= 1 in every fixed and 60 s-aligned rolling 600 s window, and total delta per scope <= 6
legitimate denials per issue (no pre-set acceptance threshold; Owner decision)
no cell in which OAAA denies more legitimate requests than S0

bounded storage: credit sets <= 2, TTL <= 86 400 s, tuples <= grants, nothing alive after a day; every Redis key has a TTL

S0-family state parity after the same history (key for key)
rollback decision parity: the REAL S0 code after the OAAA history decides like after an S0-only history

F116-01 attempt-level replay idempotency: a replayed or reordered outcome never resolves another attempt or returns a unit without a new successful attempt (tuple-fungible counters cannot provide it: CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUIRED for an attempt-bound identity)

F116-02 no partial write: on the CURRENT patch every wrong-type / malformed key case is refused before any write (all involved keys unchanged); the superseded 0df807f adapter is recorded for comparison
F116-03 a pre-only route sharing a scope with outcome-reporting traffic decides like S0 (it does not: credit from other traffic admits it and its units stay spent)
